item.title: UK prime minister calls actions of Russian warship reckless but not sinister

item.description: Sudan's under-17 women's national soccer team has made its first international appearance since civil war erupted in the country

item.description: Japanese officials have expressed concern after a Chinese navy destroyer conducted live-fire drills off one of Japan’s remote islands

item.title: Ski enthusiasts flock to sub-Saharan Africa and a snowy mountain resort in Lesotho
item.description: Lesotho attracts thousands each winter to its unique ski resort, the only such tourist attraction in sub-Saharan Africa

item.title: Conflicts and energy shocks threaten progress against hunger, UN agency head warns
item.description: Conflicts and disruptions to global energy markets could push millions more people into hunger by driving up fuel, fertilizer and food costs

item.description: Lebanon's president is set to meet with U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday to conclude a visit to Washington

item.title: Nicaragua’s Ortega moves to extend 20-year rule, says no elections anytime soon
item.description: Nicaragua's President Daniel Ortega has announced that the country won’t hold elections anytime soon, a statement that reflects his effort to extend his nearly 20-year rule
